tasks.name: count_vowels
tasks.reference:
def count_vowels(s):
    return sum(1 for c in s.lower() if c in 'aeiou')
turns: Write a Python function count_vowels(s) that returns the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, either case) in s. Reply with a single Python code block containing only the function (and any helpers), no prints and no tests.

tasks.name: top_words
tests: assert top_words('a b a c b a', 2) == [('a', 3), ('b', 2)]
assert top_words('Dog dog cat. Cat bird', 3) == [('cat', 2), ('dog', 2), ('bird', 1)]
tasks.reference:
import re
from collections import Counter
def top_words(text, k):
    c = Counter(w for w in re.findall(r'[A-Za-z]+', text.lower()))
    return sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[:k]
turns: Write a Python function top_words(text, k) that returns the k most frequent lower-cased words (letters only, split on non-letters) as a list of (word, count) tuples, most frequent first, ties broken alphabetically. Reply with a single Python code block containing only the function (and any helpers), no prints and no tests.

tasks.name: diag_sum
tasks.reference:
def diag_sum(m):
    return sum(m[i][i] for i in range(len(m)))
turns: Write a Python function diag_sum(m) that returns the sum of the main diagonal of a square list-of-lists matrix m; diag_sum([]) returns 0. Reply with a single Python code block containing only the function (and any helpers), no prints and no tests.

tasks.name: chunk
tasks.reference:
def chunk(xs, n):
    return [xs[i:i + n] for i in range(0, len(xs), n)]
turns: Write a Python function chunk(xs, n) that splits the list xs into consecutive chunks of length n (the last chunk may be shorter); chunk([], n) returns []. Reply with a single Python code block containing only the function (and any helpers), no prints and no tests.
